description: DUT discards a TCP packet whose source port differs from the established peer's port (RFC 793 §3.1 / §3.9 4-tuple demux)
approach:
[Objective]
TCP demuxes by 4-tuple (src_ip, src_port, dst_ip, dst_port). A segment with a different src_port doesn't match the established connection — it must be dropped (or trigger RST per CLOSED-state rules).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake on src_port=K.
2. Tester → DUT: data segment with src_port=K' (≠K).
3. Observation: DUT must NOT acknowledge the data on the established socket.

[Pass condition]
No ACK to wrong-source-port data.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_unexpected_ack — DUT acked the wrong-port segment

verdicts.Fail_unexpected_ack: DUT acked segment with wrong source port
